newsitem.title: UK: London palladium fixed at two-month low of $162.00.
newsitem.headline: London palladium fixed at two-month low of $162.00.

text.p: Palladium was fixed sharply lower on Thursday afternoon at $162.00 an ounce, the lowest fixing since May 8, compared to $168.00 in the morning.
Prices ticked lower after dealers confirmed that long-delayed Russian exports to Japan had resumed.
Palladium had hit a 17-year high of $240.00 last month due to its scarcity resulting from Russia being out of the market since December.
But dealers said the price would probably have to fall evern further before consumers, wary after months of uncertainty, began to re-stock depleted inventories.
It might not be until next year before normal trading conditions returned to the market, one dealer said.
Its sister metal platinum, which had hit a seven-year high fix of $497.00 last month, was also easing and fixed lower at $396.00 compared to $397.00 in the morning.
